name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text:
The European Parliament marks 35 years since the 1991 attack on Vukovar and nearby Škabrnja, where Yugoslav army and Serb forces killed civilians and prisoners. It honours the victims and condemns the crimes. It asks Western Balkan countries to find missing people, open their archives, cooperate with courts, and stop glorifying convicted war criminals. It also asks the European Commission to keep these issues central in EU membership talks and to fund groups that document the crimes. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- No law changes; the Parliament calls on Western Balkan governments and the EU Commission to act.
- It affects victims' families, missing-person groups and countries seeking EU membership.
- Next: the text goes to EU institutions and Western Balkan governments; no binding steps follow.
